title: Your Outlet Is 120 Volts. This Electric Car Uses 1,200 #shorts

scenes.text: Your wall outlet runs on one hundred twenty volts. The newest electric hypercar runs on twelve hundred.
Most electric cars use about four hundred volts. In twenty nineteen, Porsche's Taycan went to eight hundred.
Why? Double the volts, and you need half the current for the same power.
Half the current means a quarter of the heat in the wires. Slimmer cables, faster charging.
Now B Y D sells thousand volt cars, claiming four hundred kilometers of range in five minutes.
So how high can it go? Two thousand volts? Guess below. Follow EV Drive.
